notes: Physical server hardware repairs (2010, HDD-heavy servers): 20 replacements on ~9 of 100 servers per 14 months (PDF, status V). All repairs are treated as host loss (data lost on local disks): pessimistic. frailty_a from P(N>=1)=0.09 and E[N|N>=1]=2.22 via a gamma-Poisson model: strong lemon effect.

VM crash tickets (server unresponsive/unreachable), all causes, as one transient cause (the paper gives no data-loss rate). Rate central = mean weekly failure rate (Fig 2), high = Table V weekly failure probability. Duration: lognormal matched to the reported median (3.13 h) and mean (19.6 h); the paper's own fit (sigma ~2-2.9) has a much larger mean than the data, so it is not used. Repair = ticket open to close, including queueing. Recurrence within a week is 42.1x the random weekly probability; frailty_a = 1/(ratio - 1) (gamma-Poisson: E[Z | failed] = 1 + 1/a), opt-in. Inter-failure Gamma shape 0.44 (bursty) is recorded in shape_variant.
